continuity.method: world joint positions (body shift with the chair) at the clip keys; seam velocity from one-frame differences on each side; acceleration = second difference / dt^2; captures: the raw mh_mx clips (their whole key range) under the same formula

ergonomics.method: joint centres in UE world: elbow = ForeArm joint z - worktop top; upper arm = angle of Arm->ForeArm from straight down; shoulder elevation = Shoulder->Arm clavicle elevation, minus the SeatedIdle mean; wrist (judged) = the hand long axis (wrist -> middle knuckle) carried into the forearm's bind frame, decomposed on the bind palm-normal (flexion +, toward the palm) and radial (deviation +) axes, i.e. relative to the rig's straight bind hand: the TOTAL angle of the pose, independent of any solver correction. Context only: the same decomposition of the elbow->wrist joint line in the hand frame (joint-centre geometry; the bind hand itself reads non-zero on it)
